title: Still Jazz to Me
style: Jazzy blues with modern funk influence at 105 BPM. Fat, groovy modern bass line with slap and walking elements. Female vocalist Jazz with bluesy, soulful delivery mixed with jazz phrasing and playful scat. Strong swinging jazz harmony underneath the funk groove. Cool, confident, and musical production. Bluesy feel on top but clearly rooted in jazz. Modern bass-driven funk meets classic jazz swing.
lyrics:
[Intro – Jazz, bluesy and smooth over funky bass]
Mmm… yeah…
I heard that bass line thumpin’
Blues in the vocal, but the spirit is jumpin’
It’s still jazz to me…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
You got that low-end rumble, modern and mean
Funk in the pocket, but the changes are clean
Blues in the story, pain in the tone
But the swing is alive, and it’s making me moan
[Pre-Chorus]
They call it something new, they call it something old
But when the bass starts walking, the truth gets told
[Chorus – Jazz]
It’s still jazz to me
Even with the funk, even with the heat
Blues on the surface, but the soul runs deep
It’s still jazz to me… yeah, it’s still jazz to me
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
Modern bass thumping, slapping real hard
But the piano’s comping like it’s playing its part
Scat in the middle when the feeling gets right
Blues in the night, but the jazz stays in sight
[Chorus]
It’s still jazz to me
Funk in the bass, but the swing is free
Doesn’t matter the flavor, the root is the key
It’s still jazz to me…
[Scat Break – Jazz (bluesy with funky rhythmic edge)]
Doo-bee-doo… wah-wah…
Bop-bee… scat-scat…
Funky bass… but it’s jazz…
Bee-boo-bop… still jazz to me…
[Bridge – Jazz]
You can dress it up, you can break it down
Add a little funk, turn the volume up loud
But when the music hits and the feeling is true
No matter the style… it’s still jazz to you
[Final Chorus – Groovy and confident]
It’s still jazz to me
Blues in the voice, funk in the bass, swing in the beat
Call it what you want, but the truth is sweet
It’s still jazz to me… it’s still jazz to me
[Outro – Jazz over fading funky bass]
Still jazz…
Bee boo bop…
It’s still jazz to me…
